item.title: US federal agencies missed the July 18 GENIUS Act deadline to finalize stablecoin licensing and issuer oversight rules.
SEC proposed Regulation Crypto, offering temporary registration exemptions for developers of crypto investment contracts.
WEMIX stablecoin contract breach enabled 5.23 million unauthorized WEMIX$ tokens to be minted; bridges and pools suspended.
JPMorgan began accepting BlackRock iShares Bitcoin Trust shares as collateral for client loans.
Bitcoin and Ethereum bridge protocols lost $35 million in multiple coordinated exploits within a six-hour window on July 23.
AFX Trade lost $24.15 million after attackers compromised validator signing keys for its Arbitrum bridge.
US CLARITY Act digital asset market-structure legislation faces a narrow Senate floor window with seven Democrats undecided.
Europe MiCA compliance costs may accelerate M&A consolidation as smaller crypto firms struggle to sustain licensing.
UK FCA finalized crypto asset custody and stablecoin issuance rules; firms have until 2027 to achieve full compliance.
Australia Travel Rule implementation now requires identity data exchange for all regulated crypto transfers effective July 1.
Taiwan enacted a banking law giving licensed banks first-mover advantage in stablecoin issuance under the new crypto framework.
Ostium lost $18 million after an attacker submitted manipulated future-timestamped oracle reports to exploit price-feed automation.
BIS research found a $3.5 billion stablecoin inflow shifts three-month US Treasury bill yields by approximately 4 basis points.
Security researchers patched an Aptos consensus vulnerability that could have exposed up to $70 billion in cross-chain assets.
